name: "Infernoble Arms - Joyeuse"
card_text: While this card is equipped to a monster: You can target 1 FIRE Warrior monster in your GY; add it to your hand, then destroy this card. You can only use 1 ""Infernoble Arms - Joyeuse"" effect per turn, and only once that turn.
